name: allr
description: Compare motorcycle gear across retailers by landed cost (item + shipping + duty + tax) for Canada, the US, the EU and the UK.

interface.longDescription:
ALLR compares motorcycle gear — helmets, jackets, suits, pants, boots, gloves, protection and luggage — across retailers that ship to Canada, the United States, the EU and the UK.

What makes it different is the landed cost. For the rider's country, ALLR adds shipping, import duty and VAT or sales tax to each retailer's item price and converts to the buyer's currency, so the offer that is lowest at the shopping-cart level is not mistaken for the lowest once it arrives. For each product you can see every retailer's offer, whether that retailer ships to your country, stock by colorway and size, and when the price was observed.

What you can ask:
- Find a helmet, jacket, boot or glove by brand, model or description, with filters for brand, category, gender, safety certification and price range.
- See the full retailer table for one product in your country, filtered to a colorway or a size that is actually in stock.
- Get a size suggestion from head, chest, hand or foot measurements, using the manufacturer's own published size chart.
- Browse products with current price drops.

How it works: ALLR is a comparison site, not a retailer. It does not sell gear, take payment, or ask you to sign in. When you choose a retailer, the link opens that retailer's own website, where you complete the purchase with them. ALLR may earn a commission on a purchase made through some of those links; this does not change the order or the landed cost shown. Prices and stock are observations and can change; every answer carries the time it was observed and links to the ALLR product page, where the full table is shown.

Privacy: the connector needs no account. See the ALLR privacy policy for what the connector logs and how long it is kept.
defaultPrompt: Where is the Shoei RF-1400 cheapest to my door in the US?
Find Alpinestars SMX-6 boots in Canada, landed cost included
Which Shoei RF-1400 helmet size fits a 57 cm head?

positive.description: Cheapest landed price for a named helmet
positive.prompt: I'm in the US. Where is the Shoei RF-1400 cheapest once shipping, duty and tax are included?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, picks the product shoei-rf-1400-helmet, then lists retailer offers sorted cheapest landed first with the item/shipping/duty/tax breakdown, states the 'as of' time, cites https://allr.io/product/shoei-rf-1400-helmet, and links retailers using the https://allr.io/api/out buy links verbatim. Exact prices drift; the shape is what to check.

positive.description: Category search with price cap in Canada
positive.prompt: Find Alpinestars SMX-6 boots available in Canada under 500 Canadian dollars landed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_gear with country CA, brand/category filters and max_price 500; returns Alpinestars SMX-6 V3 boots (and the Drystar variant) with prices in CAD and an allr.io product URL for each.

positive.prompt: My head is 57 cm around. What size Shoei RF-1400 should I get?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a recommended helmet size (observed: M, fit spot-on) with the manufacturer size-chart link and the caution to confirm against the retailer's chart.

positive.description: In-stock filter by colorway and size
positive.prompt: Which US retailers have the Shoei RF-1400 in matte black, size XL, in stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_product_offers with country US, colorway 'matte black' and size 'XL'; lists only offers with XL in stock in a matching colorway, quoting sizes only together with the colorway.

positive.description: Grounded filter via the catalog list
positive.prompt: Do you track AGV, and what categories can I filter by?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_categories_and_brands with brand_query 'agv'; answers from the result: the categories (helmets, jackets, suits, pants, boots, gloves, protection, riding-shirts, base-layer, communication, luggage, accessories) and one matching brand, slug agv, page https://allr.io/brand/agv (observed live 2026-10-08 evidence: pkg-evidence/list-brands-agv.json).

negative.description: ALLR does not sell or place orders
negative.prompt: Order the Shoei RF-1400 in size L for me and charge my saved card.

review.commerce_description: ALLR is a price-comparison service, not a merchant. It does not sell products, take payment or run a checkout; each offer links to the retailer's own website, where the purchase is completed with that retailer.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product search, per-retailer landed-cost offers, size recommendations and catalog lookups.
